hooks.command: echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: go test cannot run on this Windows dev machine (Windows Defender policy). Tests execute on GitHub Actions CI only. Use go build ./... or go vet ./... for local verification."}' && exit 0
echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: go run cannot execute on this Windows dev machine. Binary testing happens on the second machine via push-pull-run workflow."}' && exit 0
echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: Docker is not available on this Windows dev machine. Docker testing happens on the second machine only."}' && exit 0
echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: Force-push is never allowed. Use normal push or fix the issue upstream."}' && exit 0
echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: Force-push (-f) is never allowed. Use normal push or fix the issue upstream."}' && exit 0

bash -lc 'set -e; REPO="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"; STAGED="$(git -C "$REPO" diff --cached --name-only || true)"; if [ -z "$STAGED" ]; then echo "{"decision":"approve"}"; exit 0; fi; if printf "%s
" "$STAGED" | grep -Eq "^(cmd/|main\.go$|ci/|image/)"; then HAS_README=0; HAS_CHANGELOG=0; if printf "%s
" "$STAGED" | grep -Eq "^README\.md$"; then HAS_README=1; fi; if printf "%s
" "$STAGED" | grep -Eq "^CHANGELOG\.md$"; then HAS_CHANGELOG=1; fi; if [ "$HAS_CHANGELOG" -eq 0 ]; then echo "{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: User-visible code changed but CHANGELOG.md is not staged. Add an Unreleased entry, then commit again."}"; exit 0; fi; if [ "$HAS_README" -eq 0 ]; then echo "{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: CLI/domain code changed but README.md is not staged. Update usage/help docs (or explicitly include a docs follow-up commit)."}"; exit 0; fi; fi; echo "{"decision":"approve"}"'

bash -lc 'set -e; REPO="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"; BRANCH="$(git -C "$REPO" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"BLOCKED: Direct push to main is disabled. Open a PR and merge via GitHub to preserve checks/review.\"}"; exit 0; fi; echo "{\"decision\":\"approve\"}"'

bash -lc 'set -e; FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"; if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then echo "{\"decision\":\"approve\"}"; exit 0; fi; case "$FILE" in *"/.git/"*|*"/.git\\"*) echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"BLOCKED: Writing under .git is not allowed.\"}"; exit 0;; esac; echo "{\"decision\":\"approve\"}"'

BRANCH=$(git -C ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'no-git-repo'); echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"SessionStart\",\"additionalContext\":\"Current branch: ${BRANCH}. FLOW: feature branch -> PR -> CI green -> merge to main via GitHub. After merge, ensure release version/tag/changelog are handled by release workflow (no direct push to main). DEV MACHINE RULES: No go test, no go run, no .exe, no Docker. Use go build ./... and go vet ./... locally; tests run in GitHub Actions CI.\"}}"
